experiments.question: Does a magnitude-only adaptive gate avoid the direction distortion criticized in the 2026-09-22 meeting while preserving or improving Bounded behavior?
experiments.start: sealed Q17/BOR R151-after identity used by post-advisor rank32 work
experiments.baseline: reuse already-sealed historical rank128 Bounded R152-R159; do not rerun baseline

treatment.raw_update_training: identical objective/data/replay semantics to matched Simple Bounded
treatment.gate: For nonzero delta, normalize exactly by ||delta||_F and write beta*delta; for zero delta record a no-op and undefined cosine. Select beta from [0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0] by minimum NLL on the same current+replay training batches used to fit the raw update.
treatment.direction_invariant: For nonzero delta, cos(delta, gated_delta)=1 by construction. Beta=0 is excluded prospectively before formal consumption so replay/noop semantics cannot become a second treatment variable; zero updates have undefined cosine.
treatment.selector_scope: within-training-objective selector; this protocol makes no claim that beta selection generalizes
treatment.selector_reporting: per-round loss and sample count for every beta, selected beta for each round, and selection frequencies across R152-R159

experiments.stop_rule: complete exactly R152-R159 or stop only on typed integrity/runtime blocker

experiments.stage2_budget: At pinned SEED commit 2cf2fadca3c5aba28da68e8e1405182ba8d90e6c, use TRAIN_DATA_SIZE=16, data.train_batch_size=16, GROUP_SIZE=8, and trainer.total_epochs=160. The launcher selects 16 training rows; the pinned trainer uses drop_last=true, so len(train_dataloader)=1 and total_training_steps=len(train_dataloader)*total_epochs=160 policy updates. This is 128 rollout slots per update and 20480 rollout slots total. Do not override these budget values or stop based on scores.
